entries.title: Basil Lost a Race to a SNAIL! Which Fix Works?

moments.what: Pick the fix: pedal faster, all three parts, or chain and brakes
Each part has a job: the bell warns people you are coming
The brakes help a bike slow down and stop safely
The chain joins the pedals to the back wheel
Look closer: every part has its own function
Be a chain link: the parts interact
When one part stops, the whole bike is likely to be affected
Your body is made up of systems too
A tree is a system: roots, stem and leaves
